# Code of conduct

ThirtyS3 follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). It applies to issues, pull requests, discussions and every other place connected to the project.

In short:

- Be welcoming and respectful, whatever someone's background or experience.
- Discuss ideas, not people. Disagree politely and accept that others may decide differently.
- No harassment, insults, sexual language or imagery, or publishing other people's private information.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour to the maintainers at **thirtyfile@gmail.com**. Every report is read and handled privately. The maintainers may remove comments, lock conversations, or block people who don't follow this code, as described in the Contributor Covenant's enforcement guidelines.
